record.label: Logical qubits and spacetime cost over 500 runs
record.description: The solution uses $Q=4{,}338$ logical qubits. Appendix G gives a spacetime cost of $229{,}357{,}900{,}876{,}653{,}900$ over all 500 runs. For gates conditioned on measurement outcomes, the paper counts $T$ gates on the most expensive outcome branch.
